correctness.rationale: For natural stationary initialization, invariant beta-mixture M-blocks yield exact p_k. A shared-uniform coupling contracts on the M^2 scale. Factorial moments split widely spaced and clustered starts; each extra close start costs q^(k-M) and the total close-cluster error is O(M^(beta+3) log n/n), hence a point-process Poisson limit. A vanishing boundary run and tau_M ->0 yield continuous Gumbel. The standalone rational checker passes 936 assertions but does not prove limits.

value.rationale: The length and temporal positions of successive universal-vertex arrivals form a natural extreme-growth statistic in Pólya threshold graphs. The theorem identifies an explicit parameter-dependent critical streak length and a continuous law qualitatively different from fixed-M lattice oscillations. The stated uniform-in-M mixing and rarity scales are structural and cannot be read from graph edge-count Gaussian results.
